final: WITH s AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer WHERE store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), sh AS (SELECT s.store_id, s.cnt, CAST(s.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM s, t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh WHERE share IS NOT NULL) SELECT sh.store_id, sh.cnt, sh.share, sh.share - a.avg_share AS share_diff FROM sh, a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND sh.share IS NOT NULL AND sh.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY (share_diff IS NULL), share_diff DESC LIMIT 10
